Heroin and cannabis seized in Mizoram and Amritsar

Mizoram Police in Saitual seized heroin valued at Rs 1.74 crore and arrested two individuals. In a separate incident, police in Amritsar busted illegal drug modules, seizing 10 pistols and 2 kg of heroin. Over the course of a week in Mizoram, a total of 1.28 kg of heroin and 18.52 kg of cannabis were confiscated, leading to six arrests.
